profile.acceptance: All four gates must pass. A result admits only unchanged frozen physics, this exact grid, and A01 first128/D01 first64 smoke. No automatically inherited previous qualification.
profile.clock_semantics: integer tick deltas / 10000000 seconds; exact SQL-style display compatibility is not creator attribution
profile.predeclared_refinement_anchors: positive locked-gap min, middle, max; global gap p95,p99,max, deduplicated
profile.refractory_change: A different physical model (0.2s), not a correction of old 0.1s evidence.
scope_limits: all 325 global gaps: positivity/mass interface audit only; not full-dataset learning qualification
perpetual fixed-step values and refinements: common conditioned Gaussian prior only
row continuation defects and row perpetual errors are diagnostics, not certified bounds
unconditioned 32/64/128-event schedules do not bound observed/conditioned network dynamics
trained likelihood depends on physical channels and content; local transport errors may amplify; no universal rollout error bound
physics training, new starting laws, other durations/windows or changes require a fresh numerical profile
no accuracy ranking, independent seed training or GPU/energy/performance claims
